name: pacemaker-admin
description: Read and edit the Pacemaker home page main visuals from Claude, with a preview before every change.
long_description:
Lets a Pacemaker admin list and edit the main visuals (hero banners) on the home page of https://www.paceupcareer.com from Claude.

Every edit is proposed first and shown as a before/after list with a preview link. Nothing changes until you confirm, and each applied change is recorded in an audit log.

You sign in once in your browser with your Pacemaker admin account. The sign-in is stored in your computer's secure credential store (macOS Keychain or Windows Credential Manager). Accounts that are not admins are refused by the server.

Pacemaker 관리자가 Claude에서 홈 화면 메인 배너를 조회하고 수정할 수 있게 합니다. 수정은 항상 변경 전후와 미리보기를 먼저 보여 주고, 승인해야 적용됩니다.

tools.name: list_main_visuals
tools.description: List the home page main visuals in display order.

tools.name: get_main_visual
tools.description: Get one main visual with its description, button text and link.

tools.name: propose_main_visual_update
tools.description: Preview a change to a main visual. Writes nothing.

tools.name: apply_main_visual_update
tools.description: Apply a previewed change after you confirm. Changes the live home page.

tools.name: sign_in
tools.description: Sign in to Pacemaker in your browser, or check that you are signed in.

tools.name: sign_out
tools.description: Remove the stored sign-in from this computer.
